observedBehavior: On `http://localhost:4173/checkout.html`, after adding an item to the cart and applying coupon code `SAVE10` once, the page updated successfully to show `Applied: SAVE10`, a `−$1.40` discount, and a `$12.60` total. Clicking `Apply` again with the same `SAVE10` code immediately showed the red banner `Something went wrong applying your coupon (HTTP 500). Please try again.` while the previously applied discount remained visible. The failure state was still present after waiting 4 seconds.
expectedBehavior: Applying the same coupon a second time should not crash the checkout flow or show a 500 error banner; it should indicate that the coupon is already applied or otherwise handle the repeat action gracefully.
reproductionSteps: Click `Add to cart` on any product.
Enter coupon code `SAVE10` and click `Apply` once.
Click `Apply` again with the same `SAVE10` code still in the input.
Wait a few seconds and observe the red 500 error banner on the checkout page.
